finding_summary: Current WP603 generation 3 is a deterministic typed mechanism router, not a value estimator; R0/R1/R2/R3 mechanism semantics are distinct from nested-child depth.
Current WP605 already records exact resource telemetry for Native Child results but deliberately treats quality references as opaque and does not infer semantic quality or causal credit.
Primary RLM/RAH research supports recursion/harness value in some long-context regimes; SRLM reports recursion itself is not always the driver and can degrade within-window cases.

Architecture decision: keep WP603 pure. Produce matched recursion-value observations from evaluator-owned quality plus resource telemetry, and let the existing higher-level controller/policy synthesis generate exact R3 inputs; do not add a second learned router.
Next promotion gate is an F2 matched R0 vs R1/R2 ablation with sealed task families and comparable quality/resource telemetry.
mirror_policy: Provenance mirror only. F2 owns canonical claim/result authority.
